Auto All - Cook, Read, Tailoring and Reload
Cleaning stopped: the water ran out after %1 things.
This water is tainted. It washes exactly the same, and it does not affect infection - sterilising is what does.
No soap, bleach or cleaning liquid within reach.
There is no water here. Sinks run dry once the water supply is shut off.
Washes you, your clothes, your gear and your dirty bandages - %1 things in all. Soap, bleach or cleaning liquid in reach is used automatically, which is about five times faster.
Washes you, your clothes, your gear and your dirty bandages - %1 things in all. Water only, so it takes considerably longer.
Auto cooking stopped: the ingredient could not be added.
Nothing within reach can go into this recipe.
This item is set to hide its recipes, which is a base game setting, not a mod one - the game's own cooking options are hidden too. Right click the item and choose Show Recipes to bring them all back.
Auto Cook: recipes hidden for this item
Fills the dish on its own with the best ingredients within reach, spreading the food types so the meal does not make you unhappy. Recipe limit: %1 ingredients. Reachable now: %2.
Could not put %1 ingredient(s) back - they are still in your inventory.
Opens a window to choose the dish, what it is for, and how much of each ingredient goes in.
As many as the recipe allows
Your cooking is good enough to use the sad end of the pantry.
Left click a row to raise it, right click to lower it.
Nothing here can be taken apart right now. Worn, broken or already-used items do not count.
Those are being worn or carried. Take one off first, or use a spare.
Leaving %1 alone: worn or in hand.
Auto Dismantle: every electronic within reach
Takes apart %1 of the %2 within reach, one after another, for Electrical XP. Any that are in a container are fetched, and the screwdriver is only picked up once.
Use a car you can afford to lose
Get out of the vehicle first.
%1 parts done, but %2 could not be refitted - see console.txt.
Only parts the game rates %1 or better
Without the key, some parts stay locked.
Nothing on this car can be worked on right now.
Parts are safe at this setting
To work on seats, make sure they are empty.
%1 parts skipped: the odds are too low
Stuck on this car - %1 parts done.
Parts will break at this level!
No bandages or tools within reach.
Treats %1 injured body part(s): bullets and glass out, burns washed, wounds disinfected and bandaged. A sterilised bandage is used first when you have one.
No can opener or sharp knife within reach.
Open Every Can and Jar Within Reach
Opens %1 of the %2 within reach, one after another. Any that are in a container are fetched, and the can opener is only picked up once.
Off means only clothes, gear and bandages are washed.
Wring the clothes out and put them back on
After the washing, wrings out every wet garment and dresses the character again in whatever it was wearing. The base game takes the clothes off to wring them and leaves them in your inventory.
Use bad ingredients from Cooking level
From this Cooking level the picker stops avoiding rotten and depressing ingredients. 0 never allows them. Poison is always refused.
Stop before the recipe is full. 0 uses whatever the recipe allows.
What the picker maximises when it chooses the next ingredient.
Returns ingredients borrowed from a cupboard or fridge once the meal is done. The finished dish always stays in your inventory.
Max copies of the same ingredient
Piling the same food in a dish is what makes it depressing to eat. 2 is a safe value.
Items flagged as favourite are left alone.
Never puts poisonous items in the pot.
Never puts rotten, burnt or tainted food in the pot.
Skips ingredients that add unhappiness while a better one is still available.
How many spices at most may go into one dish.
Adds the spices you have once the ingredients are in.
Use up the food closest to spoiling
Among the ingredients on offer, prefers the ones with the least time left before they go stale. Nothing rotten is ever used - that is a separate setting.
Our Discord is where bugs get reported, ideas get discussed, people find others to play with, and new mods are announced. Come and say hello.
Opens the invite in the Steam overlay, or in your browser when the overlay is off.
Caps how many are taken apart in one go. 0 means as many as there are.
Send the scrap back where it came from

When the electronics were taken from a crate, a cupboard or the floor, the parts go back there at the end instead of weighing the character down. Used on something already carried, the parts stay in the inventory.
Put the screwdriver back when finished
Returns the screwdriver to the container it was taken from, once, after the whole batch. Turn this off to simply keep it.
Single player only - the server owns game speed in multiplayer. It is only taken from normal speed, and if you change the speed yourself the mod stops touching it for the rest of that job.

Single player only. The base game plays this sound on a failed part through the server, so it is silent when there is no server. This plays it for you. It is heard, not carried: it does not draw zombies the way the multiplayer one does.
0 means every part it can do.

Parts the game gives a lower chance than this are skipped instead of risked. 0 works on everything, 30 will not wreck the car, 100 never risks a part. The chances themselves are the game's and are never changed.
Uses alcohol or an alcoholic drink on each open wound before dressing it, exactly as the Health window would. Turn it off to save your alcohol - the bandaging still happens.
Turn off anything you do not use. Its menu entries disappear completely, so the right click menu only shows what you actually want.
On by default. A server can also switch this off for everyone in its sandbox options.
Seconds before the same progress message shows up again.
How the mod tells you what it is doing.
Caps how many are opened in one go. 0 means as many as there are.
Send the opened food back where it came from

When the tins were taken from a fridge, a crate or the floor, the opened food goes back there at the end instead of weighing the character down. Used on something already carried, it stays in the inventory.
Put the can opener back when finished
Returns the can opener or knife to the container it was taken from, once, after the whole batch. Turn this off to simply keep it.
Magazines that still hold at least one recipe you do not know.
Stops once this many books and magazines have been read.
Off means only the books already in your inventory and bags are read.
Returns each book to the container it was taken from.
Books that raise an XP multiplier, as long as the level band fits your character.
One cycle is filling the magazine and emptying it again.
0 means as many as the batch allows.
Send the strips to the source
Ripped sheets and strips go back to the container the clothing came from.
The cutting tool goes back to the container it came from, once, at the end.
Items flagged as favourite are left alone, wherever they are.
Auto All tab in the character window
Turn this off to take the tab out of the character window. Nothing is lost: every setting it holds is also here in Mod Options. Useful on a controller, where one fewer tab is one fewer to cycle past.
Put the alcohol back when finished
Returns the leftover alcohol or water to the container it was taken from, once, after the whole batch. Turn this off to simply keep it.
Stops when overall body health drops.
Stops as soon as you raise the weapon.
Pressing a movement key always stops the automation.
Stops as soon as a zombie is seen or chasing.
Which material the training sews on. Any picks the cheapest one you carry.
Sews the actual holes before padding intact parts.
One cycle is patching every body part and unpicking them all again.
Stop after this many tapes (0 = no limit)
At zero it keeps going until nothing within reach still teaches anything.
Also take tapes from nearby containers
With this on, the shelves and boxes open in the loot window count as well, not just what the character is carrying.
Put each tape back where it came from
Turn this off to keep the watched tapes in the inventory instead.
Nothing within reach still teaches you anything.
Reads every skill book and skill magazine within reach, one after the other, and puts each one back. Found now: %1 books and %2 magazines. Books above or below your level are skipped.
The magazine will be taken out of the gun first.
Reload training stopped: the reload did not go through.
Reload training stopped: the magazine is gone.
This gun feeds from a magazine - carry one to train on it.
Trains on %1, the magazine this gun feeds from. Currently %2/%3 rounds, %4 spare in the inventory. Stops when you move or press ESC.
Loads and unloads this over and over to train Reloading. Currently %1/%2 rounds, %3 spare in the inventory. Stops when you move or press ESC.
The rounds are not moving. Stopped - check console.txt.
Nothing here has a hole in it.
Not enough thread or fabric to sew with.
Auto Repair: every hole within reach
%1 holes across everything within reach, worn clothes included.
%1 more will be taken off the bodies first.
Leaving %1 alone: worn, held or favourite.
No scissors or sharp knife within reach.
Will rip %1 of the %2 within reach.
Only worn, held or favourite items here.
Not enough rubbing alcohol, spirits or hot water within reach.
Sterilizes them one after the other with the alcohol or boiled water in reach. Ready to do: %1 of %2.
Stopped: too hurt to keep carrying this.
Stopped: an action would not finish.
Patches every body part of this garment, unpicks the patches and starts over. Needs a needle, thread and rags. The garment does not have to be worn. Stops when you move or press ESC.
Tailoring training stopped: the stitch did not go through.
Tailoring training stopped: the garment is gone.
Tailoring training needs rags, denim strips or leather strips.
There is no video player nearby.
The video player has no power.
No tape within reach still teaches anything.
Plays %1 tapes through the video player one after another, taking each one out when its programme ends. Tapes that only pass the time are left alone.
The video player stopped responding. Stopped - check console.txt.
Too far from the video player to follow the programme.
Nothing you are carrying is wet enough to wring.
Wrings out %1 wet garments, one after another, putting each one back on afterwards.
Trains, rests and starts again on its own until you stop it or something interrupts.
Opens a small window with our Discord invite link.
Hungry, but no safe food in the bag...
The AUTO box starts ticked when the fitness panel opens.
Eats from the inventory when hunger kicks in. Skips rotten, dangerous raw, poisonous food and spices.
How much of the container is drunk per sip.
1 = peckish, 4 = starving. Only the needed fraction of the item is eaten, so nothing is wasted.
Single player only. The server owns game speed in multiplayer.
Without this the game drops back to normal speed between sets.
Never drink above this intoxication level.
How many sets it does per run before stopping on its own. 0 trains until you stop it.
How far around the character to look for items.
Seconds before the same waiting message shows up again.
How the mod tells you what it is doing.
Pain moodle level that triggers it
Returns what was not fully consumed to the container or the floor it came from.
The character ends the set and rests when endurance drops to this value.
Prefers a bed, couch or mat within reach over the ground; walks back to the training spot afterwards.
The character stands up and starts the next set at this endurance.
One exercise per set, cycling through every exercise you have the equipment for.
In-game minutes per set. The value on the fitness panel wins when you press OK.
A small card with sets, time and XP gained appears for a few seconds when auto training stops.
Sit on the ground to rest
Stops when overall body health drops.
Stops when the heavy load moodle gets too high.
Stops when overall body health is below the limit below.
Stops when you move or aim.
Stop when the panel is closed
Off means training keeps going with the window closed.
Stops as soon as a zombie is seen or chasing.
How far the character will walk to a rest spot or, with FWO installed, to the treadmill/bench.
Take something for the pain while resting instead of just waiting.
Falls back to an alcoholic drink when there are no painkillers.
Also takes food, painkillers and drinks from bags, containers and the floor around, walking there if needed.
Swallows a painkiller from the inventory.
Auto training is already running. Use Cancel to stop it.
Auto training stopped: the exercise could not start.
Auto training stopped: you are taking damage.
Auto training stopped: health too low.
Auto training stopped: carrying too much.
Auto training stopped: inside a vehicle.
Having a sip for the pain...
In too much pain to train...
